def _login(session):
    """Login to Fedex Delivery Manager."""
    session.visit("https://www.fedex.com/en-us/home.html")
    session.click_link_by_text("Login")
    session.fill_in("username", with: ENV["FED_USER"])
    session.fill_in("password", with: ENV["FED_PASS"])
    session.click_button("Log In")
    session.click_link_by_text("Delivery Manager")
